answer: Require each voting agent to lock a stake before its vote counts: one onyx bond buys one registered identity, and a pearl attestation certifies that identity as unique. If two accounts share funding or coordinated behavior, both stakes are slashed. To cast a thousand Sybil votes an attacker must post a thousand separate bonds, so cost grows linearly while detection forfeits every stake, turning the tundra of fake agents into a losing trade.
